About us

A condominium administration office, with method

Condominio Cramor manages buildings in Rome and surroundings with a simple method: clear documents, timely communication and decisions shared at the owners' meeting.

We use digital tools for the archive and for communication with owners, and rely on professionals (lawyers, technicians, accountants) when the case requires it.

Our method

1Transparency

Readable accounts and documents always available.

2Punctuality

Deadlines, meetings and payments managed with a calendar.

3Listening

Every report is taken in charge and updated.

4Digital method

Online archive and communication, less paper and waiting.

5Legal prudence

We rely on lawyers and technicians when needed.

6Cost control

Quotes compared and contracts reviewed every year.
